init.title: Drawing options
init.description: AI drawings use an AI Task if you have one. Leave it empty to use Home Assistant's preferred AI Task, or the first one that is online. Weather drawings use any weather entity. Windy threshold is mph when the temperature unit is °F (default 15) and km/h when it is °C (default 25). Hot and cold use the same temperature unit, default 90°F / 32°C and 32°F / 0°C. Heavy rain is a percent chance, default 70. Weather alert is optional: leave it empty and alerts stay off. Photo feedback compares a camera snapshot with the sand twin after a photo drawing, and it stays off until you pick a camera. Auto Weather starts on only the first time that switch is added. No API key is stored here.

draw_weather.name: Draw weather
draw_weather.description: Draw the forecast on the sand. Uses the weather entity from Configure when condition or temperature is left out. Plays only while Power is on.

device_id.name: Table
device_id.description: Drift table. Needed only when more than one table is set up.

condition.name: Condition
condition.description: A picture name, such as windy or rain_wind. Leave empty to use the daily forecast. Allowed: sunny, partlycloudy, cloudy, hot, cold, clear_night, fog, rain, heavy_rain, thunderstorm, hail, sleet, snow, windy, alert, rain_wind, heavy_rain_wind, thunderstorm_wind, hail_wind, sleet_wind, snow_wind, fog_wind, hot_wind, cold_wind, alert_wind.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: The high to write, from -99 to 199. Leave empty to use the daily forecast.

play.name: Play
play.description: Start the drawing when Power is on. Defaults to on.

draw_photo.name: Draw photo
draw_photo.description: Turn a photo into one continuous sand drawing: a bold outline with contour lines around it. Preview writes the twin picture and does not move the ball. Confirm draws the last preview. Plays only while Power is on.

device_id.name: Table
device_id.description: Drift table. Needed only when more than one table is set up.

image.name: Photo

name.name: Name
name.description: Name in the Pattern list. Defaults to the file name or the prompt.

play.name: Play
play.description: Start the drawing when Power is on. Ignored while preview is on.

preview.name: Preview only
preview.description: Write the sand twin picture and do not upload. Defaults to on.

confirm.name: Confirm

rotate.name: Rotation
rotate.description: Turn the picture counter-clockwise, from -180 to 180 degrees.
